note: Quick-reference instrument cards rendered on category pages. status must be honest (active/closed/historical/limited).

instruments.name: Public Provident Fund (PPF)
instruments.summary: 15-year govt deposit scheme; partial withdrawals after 7 years; interest revised quarterly.

instruments.name: National Pension System (NPS)
instruments.taxTreatment: EET with 80CCD(1)(1B); 2025 exit rules allow up to 80% lump sum

instruments.name: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS)
instruments.taxTreatment: Interest fully taxable; no 80C limit (max Rs.30L incl. joint, single Rs.20L+Rs.10L for joint)
instruments.summary: 8.2% p.a. (FY 2025-26), 5-year tenure, quarterly interest; seniors 60+ (55+ early retirees).

instruments.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
instruments.summary: Girl-child scheme; 21-year maturity; withdrawal at 18 for education.

instruments.name: National Savings Certificate (NSC)
instruments.summary: 5 or 6-year govt certificates; usable as collateral; blocks Rs.80C.

instruments.name: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP)
instruments.summary: Doubles investment in ~14.5 yrs; 6.5-7% effective; post-office scheme.

instruments.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
instruments.summary: Guaranteed pension Rs.1,000-20,000/month at 60 for unorganized workers; NPS-linked.

instruments.name: EPF (Employees' Provident Fund)
instruments.minInvestment: Mandatory 12% of basic (50K+ salary); voluntary for others
instruments.summary: Statutory retirement corpus for salaried; 8.25% interest (statutory floor).

instruments.name: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB)
instruments.taxTreatment: Interest 2.5% p.a. taxable; capital gain tax-exempt on maturity; no TDS on interest
instruments.summary: Issuance discontinued from FY 2024-25; existing SGBs trade on NSE/BSE; 8-year tenure, 5-year early redemption window.

instruments.name: Government Securities (G-sec / Gilt)
instruments.minInvestment: Rs.500 (retail via PMS-like G-sec route) / 1000 via listed
instruments.taxTreatment: Coupon taxable at slab; no indexation; CG on listed sales
instruments.summary: Sovereign debt; benchmark for duration and rate risk; available via direct route and listed markets.

instruments.name: State Development Loan (SDL)
instruments.taxTreatment: Coupon taxable at slab; CG on listed sales
instruments.summary: State-govt bonds; small credit spread over central G-sec; listed on exchanges.

instruments.name: P2P Lending (RBI-regulated NBFC-P2P)
instruments.minInvestment: Typically Rs.1000-10000 per loan on platforms
instruments.taxTreatment: Interest income at slab; P2P platform charges; loss treatment complex
instruments.summary: RBI Directions 2025 consolidate P2P framework; credit spread over banks; expected loss is real.

instruments.name: ETF (Nifty, Sector, International)
instruments.taxTreatment: Index equity ETF: LCG 12.5%/STCG per regime; gold/commodity ETFs special rules
instruments.summary: Exchange-traded baskets; index ETFs track Nifty/Sensex/sector indices.

instruments.name: ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme)
instruments.summary: Shortest lock-in among equity-linked 80C instruments; equity fund risk applies.

instruments.name: REIT (Real Estate Investment Trust)
instruments.taxTreatment: 75% distribution income taxable at 30% company rate (for REIT itself); investor taxed at slab on distribution
instruments.summary: Listed commercial real estate; distribution + appreciation; monthly/quarterly payouts.

instruments.name: InvIT (Infrastructure Investment Trust)
instruments.taxTreatment: Distribution income taxable; investor taxed at slab
instruments.summary: Toll roads, power, data centers, logistics; stable cash-flow assets.

instruments.name: PMS (Portfolio Management Scheme)
instruments.minInvestment: Rs.50L (Rs.25L for single-scheme; recent SEBI floor)
instruments.taxTreatment: Gains pass-through to investor (equity timing rules apply)
instruments.summary: Discretionary managed portfolio; fees ~0.5-1.5% + 20% performance; for informed, long-horizon capital.

instruments.name: AIF (Alternative Investment Fund)
instruments.minInvestment: Rs.25L (Cat I/II/III); Rs.1Cr for some Cat II
instruments.taxTreatment: Look-through taxation to investor for Cat I/II
instruments.summary: Venture, PE, infra debt, smidcap funds; Cat I (VC/social), Cat II (PE/smids), Cat III (HFM/quant).
